questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man tilmelder sig ikke fag som vi gør på KU, det handler mere om at tilmelde sig eksamen. Generelt er underviserne rimelig behjælpelige og hvis man spørger pænt kan næsten alt lade sig gøre (Inklusiv at få rykket en eksamensdato så man kan nå at tage på Roskilde)

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: De andre lokale studerende er en god kilde til hjælp.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Den første uge er lavet til at man kan tage forskelliger kurser og så kan man vælge efter det. Man kan vente indtil eksamen med at vælge sit kursus

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det er nemt.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det er ikke så svært at bestå. Især fordi undervisningen i høj grad baserer sig på slides frem for pensum. Niveauet er højere på KU, men man går selvfølgelig også til det på en anden måde når man bare skal bestå...

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget ligesom holdundervisning. På nogle fag blev der taget fravær. Dem som mødte op fik så en anderledes eksamen som er baseret på undervisningen. Hvis ikke man møder op skal man bare op i pensum. Det er helt sikkert en del nemmere at møde op end at lade vær.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Global Social Inequality - godt fag
Contemporary Challenges: Labor Market and Inequalities - godt fag 
       De to fag handler om stort set det samme så det gør livet nemmere at have begge to på en gang
War and Security in International Relations - Kedeligt med dårlig underviser, men fedt pensum
Dirty-hands politics - Mellem. Det er politisk teori

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Global Social Inequality 
Contemporary Challenges: Labor Market and Inequalities 
Gode fag som har et stort overlap. Handler om social stratifikation.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er overhovedet ikke et foreningsliv på samme måde som vi kender det.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var nogle sportsforeninger, men alt var på italiensk så jeg fattede det ikke helt

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Aperitivo og tage dagsture rundt omkring.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Rejs i Italien. Tag hurtigtogene til Rom og Napoli

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Man skal lige indstille maven til italiensk tid. Ellers er italienerne generelt et flinkt og høfligt folkefærd, så det er ret svært at træde ved siden af.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: De er søde til at snakke (meget meget sødere end vi er herhjemme), men man skal selv opsøge dem.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Man kommer en del længere hvis man snakker lidt italiensk

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Mad og drikke og det gode vejr

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Få en apertivo på C'era una volta på via festona efter uni
Find bolig i god tid
Det hele skal nok komme, sørg for at gå rundt og kig på byen. Der sker hele tiden alt muligt

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det er faktisk rimelig koldt om vinteren (januar i hvert fald). Så hver klar på det.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det var bare en jævn fed oplevelse hele vejen igennem

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Vores lejlighed var noget gammelt lort så alt var i stykker. Vi skulle have håndværkere ude i tide og utide

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
